title: Delete Flint Oracles
objective: Delete the dormant handwritten FLINT oracle layer, retain generated production bindings, and preserve independent correctness tests

oracles: legacy N-API or static expected results

runs.command: node --test --test-name-pattern=packages publish every generated host adapter test/ffi.cjs

handoff.summary: Shrank packages/flint/index.cjs from 1,231 to 75 lines by deleting every handwritten declaration implementation and the hidden __sagejs_ffi_oracles__ table. The loader now publishes the legacy compatibility addon, overrides every declared function/resource/transfer with its generated adapter, exposes the generated manifest, and enforces the existing diagnostic N-API boundaries. Tests use static polynomial results, mathematical right-kernel verification, or the explicitly loaded legacy N-API addon as independent oracles.
risks: The reviewed native-export inventory intentionally drifts only because packages/flint/index.cjs disappeared from 35 N-API consumer lists; counts, decisions, definitions, and hashes are unchanged. The integration lane must regenerate that shared file.

The full native gate reaches the expected shared native-export inventory drift after all preceding package and FFI tests pass. The SEA gate independently reaches an existing `from mpmath import mp` smoke-test failure after successfully rebuilding FLINT, FFLAS, igraph, both executables, and their generated adapters.
next_steps: In the integration lane, regenerate and review architecture/native-exports.json, then run pnpm architecture:check.
Update FFI.md to remove the statement that handwritten dynamic implementations remain behind __sagejs_ffi_oracles__.
Replace the completed packages/flint/index.cjs TODO with the next separation step for generated production and explicitly named legacy compatibility backends.
